اغتفرتم (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرْتُمْ (iḡtafartum) /iɣ.ta.far.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرْتُمْ (uḡtufirtum) /uɣ.tu.fir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
